title: Prompt Commons: Collective Prompting as Governance for Urban AI
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the satisfaction of various subgroups, including a 'religious minority' group, with LLM outputs generated under different prompt governance models.
findings: For the 'religious minority' subgroup, satisfaction with the LLM's outputs increased under curated (M2) and veto-enabled (M3) commons governance models compared to a single-author baseline (M0). Average satisfaction across all groups rose from 4.35 on a 7-point scale for the baseline to 4.92 and 5.48 for the curated and veto-enabled models, respectively.
